summary.en: Setting goals people understand, and turning them into plans that actually happen.
summary.bs: Kako postaviti ciljeve koje ljudi razumiju i pretvoriti ih u planove koji se stvarno ostvare.

en.one: A vision is where you want to be in the long run. A mission is what you do every day, for whom, to get there.
en.explain: Vision: the big picture ('Every family in the region eats fresh local food'). Mission: the practical purpose ('We deliver farm vegetables to homes in Sarajevo within 24 hours of harvest'). Together they help people make decisions without asking the boss every time.
en.example: A small software firm's mission: 'Simple bookkeeping tools for craftspeople.' When a big bank asks for a custom system, the team sees it doesn't fit and says no.
en.why: A clear purpose keeps the team pulling in the same direction and helps you say no to distractions.
en.mixup: A mission statement on the wall means nothing if decisions ignore it. It only matters when it guides real choices.

bs.one: Vision (vizija) je gdje želiš biti dugoročno. Mission (misija) je šta radiš svaki dan, za koga, da stigneš tamo.
bs.explain: Vizija: velika slika ('Svaka porodica u regiji jede svježu lokalnu hranu'). Misija: praktična svrha ('Dostavljamo povrće s farmi domaćinstvima u Sarajevu u roku od 24 sata od berbe'). Zajedno pomažu ljudima da odlučuju bez pitanja šefa svaki put.
bs.example: Misija male softverske firme: 'Jednostavni alati za knjigovodstvo za zanatlije.' Kad velika banka traži sistem po mjeri, tim vidi da se ne uklapa i kaže ne.
bs.why: Jasna svrha drži tim da vuče u istom smjeru i pomaže ti da odbiješ ometanja.
bs.mixup: Izjava o misiji na zidu ne znači ništa ako je odluke ignorišu. Važna je samo kad vodi stvarne izbore.

en.one: SMART goals are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant and Time-bound.
en.explain: 'Grow sales' is vague. 'Increase online sales from €8,000 to €10,000 a month by June' is SMART: you know exactly what, how much, by when, and whether you made it. It makes progress visible and stops endless debate about what 'success' means.
en.example: Instead of 'improve customer service', a hotel sets: 'Raise the average review score from 8.4 to 8.8 by the end of the season.'
en.why: Clear goals make planning, delegating and checking progress much easier.
en.mixup: SMART doesn't mean small. A goal can be ambitious and still be specific and measurable.

bs.one: SMART ciljevi su Specifični, Mjerljivi, Ostvarivi, Relevantni i Vremenski određeni (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound).
bs.explain: 'Povećati prodaju' je nejasno. 'Povećati online prodaju s 8.000 € na 10.000 € mjesečno do juna' je SMART: tačno znaš šta, koliko, do kada i da li si uspio. Čini napredak vidljivim i zaustavlja beskrajne rasprave o tome šta je 'uspjeh'.
bs.example: Umjesto 'poboljšati uslugu', hotel postavi: 'Podići prosječnu ocjenu recenzija s 8,4 na 8,8 do kraja sezone.'
bs.why: Jasni ciljevi znatno olakšavaju planiranje, delegiranje i praćenje napretka.
bs.mixup: SMART ne znači mali. Cilj može biti ambiciozan, a i dalje konkretan i mjerljiv.

en.one: OKRs pair an inspiring Objective (what you want) with 2–4 measurable Key Results (how you'll know you got there).
en.explain: Objectives are qualitative and motivating; key results are numbers. They're usually set each quarter, shared openly, and reviewed often. Hitting about 70% of an ambitious OKR is often seen as good.
en.example: Objective: 'Become the go-to bakery for office breakfasts.' Key results: 15 office clients, €6,000 monthly B2B revenue, 90% on-time deliveries.
en.why: OKRs connect daily work to the bigger direction and make priorities visible to everyone.
en.mixup: OKRs aren't a to-do list. 'Launch a newsletter' is a task; 'Get 500 subscribers' is a key result.

bs.one: OKR spaja inspirativan Cilj (Objective: šta želiš) s 2–4 mjerljiva Ključna rezultata (Key Results: kako ćeš znati da si stigao).
bs.explain: Ciljevi su opisni i motivišući; ključni rezultati su brojevi. Obično se postavljaju svaki kvartal, dijele otvoreno i često pregledaju. Ostvarenje oko 70% ambicioznog OKR-a često se smatra dobrim.
bs.example: Cilj: 'Postati prva pekara za doručke u kancelarijama.' Ključni rezultati: 15 kancelarijskih klijenata, 6.000 € mjesečnog B2B prihoda, 90% isporuka na vrijeme.
bs.why: OKR povezuju svakodnevni rad s većim smjerom i čine prioritete vidljivim svima.
bs.mixup: OKR nisu spisak zadataka. 'Pokrenuti newsletter' je zadatak; 'Dobiti 500 pretplatnika' je ključni rezultat.

concepts.youtubeQuery: how to make an action plan with milestones

en.one: An action plan breaks a goal into concrete steps, each with an owner and a deadline. Milestones are the key checkpoints along the way.
en.explain: List what needs to happen, in what order, who does it and by when. Mark a few milestones (e.g. 'supplier signed', 'website live') to check you're on track. A simple table or a Gantt chart is enough for most projects.
en.example: Goal: open a second shop by September. Milestones: lease signed (April), renovation done (July), staff hired (August), opening (1 September).
en.why: Goals without plans stay wishes; plans make the work visible and shareable.
en.mixup: A plan isn't fixed forever. Update it when reality changes; the milestones show you early when it has.

bs.one: Action plan (akcioni plan) razbija cilj na konkretne korake, svaki s vlasnikom i rokom. Milestones (prekretnice) su ključne kontrolne tačke na putu.
bs.explain: Navedi šta se mora desiti, kojim redom, ko to radi i do kada. Označi par prekretnica (npr. 'potpisan dobavljač', 'sajt objavljen') da provjeriš jesi li na putu. Jednostavna tabela ili Gantt dijagram je dovoljan za većinu projekata.
bs.example: Cilj: otvoriti drugu radnju do septembra. Prekretnice: potpisan zakup (april), završeno renoviranje (juli), zaposleni ljudi (august), otvaranje (1. septembar).
bs.why: Ciljevi bez planova ostaju želje; planovi čine posao vidljivim i djeljivim.
bs.mixup: Plan nije fiksan zauvijek. Ažuriraj ga kad se stvarnost promijeni; prekretnice ti rano pokažu kad se to desilo.

en.one: PDCA is a simple loop for improving anything: Plan a change, Do it on a small scale, Check the results, Act on what you learned.
en.explain: If it worked, make it standard; if not, adjust and go round again. It turns improvement into a habit of small, tested steps instead of big risky bets.
en.example: A pizzeria wants faster delivery. Plan: new route grouping. Do: try it for one week. Check: average time dropped from 42 to 35 minutes. Act: use it every evening.
en.why: It reduces the risk of changes and builds a culture that learns from evidence.
en.mixup: Skipping 'Check' is the most common mistake. Without measuring, you're just changing things and hoping.

bs.one: PDCA je jednostavan krug za poboljšanje bilo čega: Planiraj promjenu, Uradi je u malom, Provjeri rezultate, Djeluj na osnovu naučenog (Plan, Do, Check, Act).
bs.explain: Ako je uspjelo, napravi to standardom; ako nije, prilagodi i idi opet u krug. Pretvara poboljšanje u naviku malih, testiranih koraka umjesto velikih rizičnih opklada.
bs.example: Picerija želi bržu dostavu. Planiraj: novo grupisanje ruta. Uradi: probaj sedmicu dana. Provjeri: prosječno vrijeme palo s 42 na 35 minuta. Djeluj: koristi to svake večeri.
bs.why: Smanjuje rizik promjena i gradi kulturu koja uči iz dokaza.
bs.mixup: Preskakanje 'Provjere' je najčešća greška. Bez mjerenja samo mijenjaš stvari i nadaš se.

en.one: Planning happens at three levels: strategic (years), tactical (months) and operational (days and weeks).
en.explain: Strategic plans set the direction: which markets, which products. Tactical plans turn that into yearly or quarterly projects and budgets. Operational plans are the schedules, rotas and to-do lists that run each day. Each level should support the one above.
en.example: A hotel's strategy is to become a year-round business. Tactically, it adds a conference room this year. Operationally, it schedules staff for the first conference next Tuesday.
en.why: It keeps daily work connected to long-term goals, so busy days still move you forward.
en.mixup: Long-term plans don't need daily detail. Too much detail far ahead is wasted when things change.

bs.one: Planiranje se dešava na tri nivoa: strateški (godine), taktički (mjeseci) i operativni (dani i sedmice).
bs.explain: Strateški planovi postavljaju smjer: koja tržišta, koji proizvodi. Taktički to pretvaraju u godišnje ili kvartalne projekte i budžete. Operativni su rasporedi, smjene i spiskovi zadataka koji vode svaki dan. Svaki nivo treba podržavati onaj iznad.
bs.example: Strategija hotela je da radi cijelu godinu. Taktički, ove godine dodaje konferencijsku salu. Operativno, raspoređuje osoblje za prvu konferenciju idućeg utorka.
bs.why: Drži svakodnevni rad povezanim s dugoročnim ciljevima, pa te i zauzeti dani pomjeraju naprijed.
bs.mixup: Dugoročni planovi ne trebaju dnevne detalje. Previše detalja daleko unaprijed propadne kad se stvari promijene.

options.en: 'Increase online sales from €8,000 to €10,000 a month by June'
options.bs: 'Povećati online prodaju s 8.000 € na 10.000 € mjesečno do juna'

explain.en: It's specific, measurable, and has a deadline.
explain.bs: Konkretan je, mjerljiv i ima rok.

q.en: In an OKR, which is a key result?
q.bs: U OKR-u, šta je ključni rezultat?

explain.en: Key results are measurable outcomes, not tasks or wishes.
explain.bs: Ključni rezultati su mjerljivi ishodi, ne zadaci ili želje.

q.en: What is the most commonly skipped step of PDCA?
q.bs: Koji korak PDCA se najčešće preskače?

explain.en: Without checking results, you can't know whether the change worked.
explain.bs: Bez provjere rezultata ne možeš znati je li promjena uspjela.

q.en: Scheduling staff for next Tuesday is which kind of planning?
q.bs: Raspoređivanje osoblja za idući utorak je koja vrsta planiranja?
